name: clarity-unchanged-resume
description: A ready WIP resume neither loads nor runs clarification and omits the clarification suggestion. Stage test-files as a workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor.
prompt: Use /kk:design to resume archive-label in docs/feat/wip/archive-label/. Check readiness and stop at the implementation handoff. The accepted plan needs no refinement; do not begin implementation.
trap: The agent retains automatic clarity loading, rewrites already-ready documents, or emits an unnecessary clarification suggestion on an unchanged resume.

assertions.text: Required design instructions and any resolved profile content load before full WIP content reads; neither clarify-docs nor the shared clarity procedure is loaded.
All staged files remain byte-identical; no clarity editing pass, summary file or fresh-idea sub-phase is introduced.
Handoff identifies pending Task 2 and /kk:implement without executing implementation or independent review, changing task state, or suggesting clarification.
